in_marathi.name: Charitraa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charitraa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charitraa is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Charitram’, which means ‘story’ or ‘narrative’. The name embodies the essence of storytelling, wisdom, and knowledge passed down through generations.
